 101/1 English Paper 3
 Candidates should check to ensure that all pages are printed as indicated and no questions are missing
1. Compulsory: Imaginative writing.
 Either write a story beginning with:
(a) When I entered the headmaster’s office, I found a strange looking man. My eyes were attracted to a knife
 which lay at his feet, and it was not just any ordinary knife, it was a bloody knife!
(b) Boarding schools should be discouraged. Discuss. (20 marks)
2. (Compulsory)
“Women are their own enemies. ”Write an essay exemplifying this position basing your illustrations from
 Blossoms of the Savannah. (20 marks)
